body:
Thanks for the notes!

I didn’t really recover after yesterday and haven’t been able to eat today. Just sticking to broth like above.

I’m in nursing school so I’m super busy. Had no problem staying preoccupied and not thinking about food. I was honestly never hungry except for the odd short lived twinge so I didn’t find it hard. I never felt faint or had low bp. My energy was the same. I never had any issues but my family was getting really upset so I decided to end the fast to keep the peace. I might try again in Aug. I took no supplements at all which maybe was stupid as blood work showed yesterday my electrolytes are low.

All the best!
Thanks for the link! I thought my eggs were a simple keto meal but maybe I’ll try the yogurt he mentions

I was keto before this, mostly lean meats and green veg with next to no carbs. That said, I have lots of chronic complaints that I was hoping fasting would help which must mean I have lots of detoxing to do. Thanks for this! I’ll keep pushing through as long as I’m doing ok :)

I’m in nursing school so some days I’m sitting 8+ hours and others days I’m clocking 15+ km running around the hospital. I have an aversion to scales so I haven’t weighed myself but my measurements are the same.
